sloka: शत्रुघ्नस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मुनिपुङ्गवः ।प्रत्युवाच महात्मानं स्वागतं ते महायशः ।। ७.६५.५ ॥
transliteration: śatrughnasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munipuṅgavaḥ ।pratyuvāca mahātmānaṁ svāgataṁ te mahāyaśaḥ ।। 7.65.5 ॥

translations.english: Hearing Shatrughna's words, the eminent sage Valmiki smiled and welcomed the great-souled and greatly renowned prince.
